name: Warsong Saw Blades
summary: Warsong Saw Blades keep the Horde's lumber machinery cutting in Ashenvale. The Warsong Clan relies on goblin-made machines for its logging, and these blades supply its clear-cutting work.

sections.title: Industrial Forestry
sections.body: In Ashenvale, the Warsong Clan's logging depends on heavy machinery supplied and maintained by goblin engineers. Axes alone cannot meet the Horde's demand for Kalimdor lumber, so steam engines and circular saws cut through raw timber. Ashenvale's ancient hardwood quickly dulls and breaks ordinary blades. Replacement saw blades must keep arriving for the mills at the Warsong Lumber Camp to keep running.

sections.title: Securing the Shipment
sections.body: Getting mechanical parts through disputed territory brings constant trouble. Hostile furbolgs and satyrs often intercept other logging supplies, while goblin contacts such as Pixel at Splintertree Post handle the saw blade shipments. Lumber master Locke Okarr gathers the blades with rope, oil, and axes to keep the camp operating despite sabotage from Ashenvale's defenders.

faq.q: What are the Warsong Saw Blades used for?
faq.answer: The blades replace parts in the circular saws and heavy lumber machinery at the Warsong Lumber Camp in southeastern Ashenvale.

faq.q: Who provides these saw blades to the Horde?
faq.answer: Goblin merchants and logisticians handle the blades. Pixel, a goblin at Splintertree Post, oversees their arrival for the Warsong outriders.

faq.q: Why does the Horde need so many saw blades?
faq.answer: Ashenvale's dense, ancient trees quickly wear down cutting edges. The Horde needs great quantities of timber to build settlements across the arid plains of Durotar and the Barrens, and constant logging wears out machinery faster than local smiths can reforge it.

faq.q: Who is collecting the logging supplies?
faq.answer: Locke Okarr, an orc who oversees supply runs from Splintertree Post, organizes the collection of saw blades, oil, ropes, and axes for delivery to the lumber camp.

angles.text: The Horde's expansion into central Kalimdor depends on Ashenvale timber, so keeping Warsong milling equipment in repair is a strategic priority.
As a night elf, you see each crate of goblin-forged saw blades as another assault on Ashenvale's ancient canopy and its sacred woodland spirits.
